rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the post-processing logic from `map_rml.py`. The logic will be moved into a new `gbad_core/postprocessing.py` module, with configurable cleanup steps.
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `Postprocessor` Class:** - Create a new class `Postprocessor` in `gbad_core/postprocessing.py`. 2. **Generalize Cleanup Steps:** - The logic from the various `remove_...` functions will be broken down into a series of generic cleanup steps (e.g., `remove_triples_by_sparql`, `apply_sparql_update`). - Each of these steps will be implemented as a method in the `Postprocessor` class. 3. **Make it Configurable:** - The `Postprocessor` will be configured with a list of cleanup steps to apply to a given RDF graph. This configuration will be passed in from the central configuration object.
